Name: Better Artisan Goods for Strawberry Cows
Author: magicalamity
Description:
I adore cometkins Better Artisan Goods mod and also love AngoraDuchess's Strawberry Cows mod and after seeing Heartpaige's Vanilla Tweaks version of Strawberry Cows artisan goods I thought I'd try my hand at making a Better Artisan Goods version, this is my first time attempting something like this. I merely changed the colours of cometkins artisan goods to match Strawberry Cows. I hope it satisfies fellow cometkins asset enjoyers like myself! 

Thanks to cometkins [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] mod for the original assets, and to angoraduchess for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23644]Strawberry Cows[/url] mod. 
If you use Vanilla Tweaks check out heartpaiges [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37911]Vanilla Tweaks Strawberry Cows[/url] retexture!
